name: tehprof-dialogs
description: Work with your TehProf Dialogs inbox — WhatsApp, Telegram, MAX and phone calls — from ChatGPT: see who is waiting, whom to call back, draft replies and update the CRM, with every outgoing action confirmed by you.

interface.longDescription:
TehProf Dialogs is a shared inbox for WhatsApp, Telegram, MAX and phone calls used by sales and support teams. This connector lets your AI assistant work with your own TehProf Dialogs account in plain words.

Ask "who has been waiting for a reply for over an hour?", "whom do I owe a callback?" or "summarise my day" and get an answer built from your real conversations, calls and call transcripts. The assistant can read a conversation and draft a reply, find the customer in your CRM (Bitrix24, amoCRM), show the deal and move it to the next stage, schedule a message or send an approved WhatsApp template.

The assistant sees exactly what you see in TehProf Dialogs — your lines, your conversations, your role. Anything that reaches a customer or changes the CRM (sending a message, a template, moving a deal, completing a conversation) is marked as a destructive action and needs your explicit confirmation first. You can disconnect the assistant at any time in TehProf Dialogs → Connect AI.

Managers and owners get a team report: who answered, called, moved, won and lost deals and got paid, deal by deal. The assistant can also start a call to a customer — it rings from your open Dialogs window after your yes.

Ready-made roles help you start: Sales (finds customers ready to buy and prepares a message for each), Secretary (a daily digest of who is waiting and whom to call back) and End of day (closes finished conversations and hands over the rest).
capabilities: See who is waiting for a reply
defaultPrompt: Who has been waiting for a reply for more than an hour?
Summarise today: unanswered chats, missed calls, what is scheduled.
Whom do I owe a callback?

positive.description: Who is waiting for a reply
positive.prompt: Who is waiting for a reply?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the customers waiting for a reply with how long each has been waiting.
Returns unanswered chats, callbacks owed and scheduled messages.

positive.prompt: Read the latest conversation and draft a reply
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the conversation and shows a draft; nothing is sent.
Lists missed calls without a follow-up.

positive.description: Add a note to a contact after confirmation
positive.prompt: Add a note to Daniyar Akhmetov's card: prefers calls after 3 pm.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the new note and asks for confirmation; after yes the note is saved on the contact in TehProf Dialogs.

negative.description: General copywriting, no inbox data needed
negative.prompt: Write a friendly WhatsApp greeting for new customers of my coffee shop.
How much does the WhatsApp Business API cost per message in Kazakhstan?

negative.description: Personal message outside the business inbox
negative.prompt: Text my mom on WhatsApp that I'll be home late tonight.

publication.release_notes: 1.6.0: new crm_stage_deals lists the CRM deals sitting on one funnel stage right now (title, amount, responsible person, card link; paged), read under the user's own CRM account. 1.5.0: new crm_funnel_load counts how many CRM deals sit on each funnel stage right now (per funnel, filterable by funnel and stage), reading counts only under the user's own CRM account. 1.4.1: a customer's voice note already transcribed in Dialogs reads as text in messages_read and the dialogue lists, under the same rights as the person's own Dialogs. New: facts answers one counted question about the work (chats, calls, deals, invoices, assistants) by line, person or day, with the cases behind the number and a passport of period, source and completeness. Team reports: manager_report, manager_deal_moves and manager_activity_details show who answered, called, moved, won and lost deals and got paid. call_start rings a customer from the operator's open Dialogs window after confirmation. MAX lines; connecting a line by QR or through Meta from the chat (line_connect).
